data.one_liner: Flutter plugin for integrating the Veriff ID verification SDK.
data.what_it_does: Allows your mobile application to launch the Veriff identity verification flow and capture verification results. It wraps the native Android and iOS Veriff SDKs into a Flutter plugin.
use_when: You need to integrate Veriff ID verification into a Flutter application.
Your app requires identity document capture and user verification.
avoid_when: You do not use Veriff as your identity verification provider.
You only need standard barcode scanning or simple camera previews without ID verification.
strengths: Official Flutter wrapper for the Veriff SDK.
Supports customizing branding elements like colors, illustrations, and layout positioning.
weaknesses: Requires maintaining native minimum SDK versions (e.g. Android minSdkVersion 26, iOS 13).
Limited documentation inside the package README, relying heavily on external developer docs.
data.setup_notes: Requires following external Veriff developer instructions for platform-specific configurations on Android and iOS.
